remediation_plan.triage_summary: Audit of Claim CLM-90281-A identifies root cause: CO-50 denial on CPT 71045.
remediation_plan.root_cause_analysis: Clinical EHR documentation establishes valid medical indications (R07.9), but claim intake crosswalk mistakenly listed non-qualifying code (M54.5), triggering adverse benefit determination CO-50.
required_evidence_criteria: Extract direct clinical quotations of physician Dr. Marcus Reed's objective findings.
Cite qualifying diagnostic code (R07.9) and applicable coverage policies.
Invoke federal ERISA 29 CFR § 2560.503-1 / ACA § 2719 statutory appeal review standards.
Demand immediate claim overturn and re-adjudication.
statutory_citations: Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act § 2719

FORMAL STATUTORY APPEAL FOR CLAIM RE-ADJUDICATION
Date: 2026-02-14
To: Appeals & Grievance Department, Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield
Re: Formal First-Level Statutory Appeal against Denial of Claim CLM-90281-A
Patient: Eleanor Vance | DOB: N/A
Member ID: ANT-8829104 | Date of Service: 2026-02-14
Disputed Service: CPT 71045 | Disputed Denial Code: CO-50
Claim Amount: $345.0

1. STATEMENT OF DISPUTE
This letter constitutes a timely, formal appeal pursuant to 29 U.S.C. § 1133 and 29 C.F.R. § 2560.503-1 disputing the adverse benefit determination issued for CPT 71045. The denial under code CO-50 is erroneous and contrary to clinical record proof and established coverage guidelines.

2. CLINICAL FACTUAL SUBSTANTIATION & DIRECT EHR EVIDENCE
The medical record clearly establishes that the disputed service was medically necessary and fully indicated.
Treating Physician Documentation:
"ASSESSMENT & PLAN: 1. Acute Chest Pain, unspecified (ICD-10: R07.9) - Primary etiology for urgent imaging. Stat chest radiograph ordered to evaluate pulmonary parenchymal infiltration or acute cardiothoracic etiology. 2. Dyspnea, unspecified (ICD-10: R06.02) - Secondary respiratory symptom. 3. Low b"
Verbatim Clinical Findings:
- Acute presentation documented by Dr. Marcus Reed.
- Primary diagnostic indication: R07.9.
- Secondary baseline complaint (M54.5) was erroneously billed as primary reason for service during registration intake.

3. STATUTORY & CODING CROSSWALK JUSTIFICATION
Under CMS Guidelines and ERISA regulations:
- Primary Qualifying Diagnosis: ICD-10 R07.9
- Procedure: CPT 71045
- Statutory Precedent: ERISA 29 C.F.R. § 2560.503-1(h)(2) requires a full and fair review taking into account all comments, documents, and records submitted.

4. DEMAND FOR REMEDY
We respectfully demand that Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield overturn this adverse determination immediately and process CPT 71045 for full contractual payment within 30 statutory days.
